name: 33634 · Tampa, FL
findings: ZIP 33634 (Tampa) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33634 (Tampa) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33634 (Tampa) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.
